long_biography.plain_text:
Restoring damaged land became the centre of Tara Getty's conservation work in South Africa. He and Jessica Getty assembled Zuka through successive land acquisitions, reconnecting habitat within the Munywana Conservancy and pairing ecological recovery with neighbouring communities' priorities.

Getty's work extends through Wild Impact, where he has served as a director since 2001, and the grant-making foundation bearing his name. These organisations support education, health, rural enterprise, wildlife protection, culture and environmental projects across Africa and the United Kingdom. A secondary school near Lake Manyara reflects the long-term approach: classroom building, staff accommodation, bursaries and community-led development have expanded access to local education.
